inicio.kicker: Selling with AI Program · course 5 of 5 · 8 lessons
inicio.titulo: Masterclass: the calm sale, from the first hello to ongoing advisory
inicio.lead: Building got easy. Trusting what was built did not. In eight lessons you lead the whole conversation with a method: you listen more than you talk, find the root pain and put a number on it, read the room, and close an ongoing advisory with a metric and a review date, with no pressure and no discount.
inicio.capa_alt: A consultant listens closely to a small business owner at a meeting table, with a notebook open.
inicio.aulas_sub: In the order the conversation happens: method and listening, diagnosis, reading the room, closing, and process.

itens: People who sell AI diagnostics, reviews, mentoring or training to companies and get stuck in the conversation, not in the technique.
People who feel they have to become someone else to sell, or who end up discounting the price to make up for their insecurity.
People who have already done courses 1 to 4 of the program and want the method for the conversation, from the first hello to the commitment.

blocos.t: What you will be able to do
itens: Listen on three levels and let the client take up most of the conversation.
Lead the diagnosis in five milestones and leave with the pain as a number, said by the client themselves.
Read the five energy signals and use three biases only with true facts.
Close an ongoing advisory in three steps, with a metric and a review date, and track the four numbers of your process.

blocos.t: Where this course fits in Professional 2030
itens: Professional 2030 has four roles: Consultant, Auditor, Mentor and Trainer. All four sell trust, not building.
This course teaches you to sell the ongoing advisory: the 90-day mentorship with managers (the Mentor role) and the monthly advisory. You don't sell the build project.
The common base it uses: ethics and limits (saying what you know and what you don't) and the conversation with the person who decides.
